lines.zh: 我蹦一下，身体压扁又弹起
lines.en: I hop, my body flattening and springing back.

lines.zh: 我跟在主人后面，离得不远
lines.en: I follow my master, close behind.

lines.zh: 我弹到石头上，滑了一下
lines.en: I bounce onto a stone and slide.

lines.zh: 我的身体在草上留下一片湿
lines.en: I leave a wet patch on the grass.

lines.zh: 我一弹一弹地穿过院子
lines.en: I bounce across the yard.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在身体上面浮着
lines.en: My eyes float on top of me.
I hit the step and bounce back.
I hop higher than I look.

lines.zh: 我不停地弹，因为停下来会塌
lines.en: I keep hopping; stopping makes me sag.

lines.zh: 我绕着主人的脚弹了一圈
lines.en: I hop a circle around my master's feet.

lines.zh: 我弹到主人的鞋上，被抖开
lines.en: I hop onto my master's shoe and am shaken off.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，弹回来
lines.en: I roll off the step and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，身体慢慢摊开
lines.en: I stop, and my body slowly spreads.
My surface rises and falls gently.

lines.zh: 我在晒太阳，暖得很舒服
lines.en: I sun myself; the warmth feels good.
A small puddle sits beside me.

lines.zh: 我把身体收成一个小球
lines.en: I gather into a small ball.

lines.zh: 草叶穿过我的身体又出来
lines.en: A grass blade passes through me and out.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，没什么理由
lines.en: I hop once, for no reason.
I watch where my master is.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉成一条长条
lines.en: I stretch my body into a long strip.
A small bug settles on me.
I wobble slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过我，地上有一点绿
lines.en: Sun passes through me; a green patch forms.
I press to the ground, cool.
I move my core to the underside.

lines.zh: 我弹起来接住一片落叶
lines.en: I hop up to catch a falling leaf.
I wait for my master to look back.
I hop in front of you and stop.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有一个小核
lines.en: There is a small core inside me.

lines.zh: 你是主人要打的那个吗
lines.en: Are you the one my master wants hit?
I edge toward your feet.
Your face shows in my surface.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，落在你的鞋边
lines.en: I hop and land by your shoe.
I stretch myself a little taller.
I bounce away from your shoe.

lines.zh: 你不像主人，我认得出来
lines.en: You are not my master; I can tell.
I bounce up beside your boots.
Crouch down and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛在顶上
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes on top.

lines.zh: 我的表面在动，是水在流
lines.en: My surface moves; it is water flowing.
I hop once to test you.
Half of me is splashed away.

lines.zh: 我在地上摊开，慢慢收回来
lines.en: I spread on the ground and slowly gather.
My core wobbles.
I shrink into a smaller blob.
I collapse into a puddle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢聚回原来的样子
lines.en: I slowly gather back into shape.
My core swings badly.
I lie flat, heaving.
A piece of my edge is gone.
I shrink behind a stone.

lines.zh: 主人给我的东西我才吃
lines.en: I only eat what my master gives.
That in your hand—may I?
I hop to your hand and wait.

lines.zh: 我的身体把东西裹住了
lines.en: My body wraps around it.
I am not hungry; I just want to swallow.
Let go and I will take it.
I hop to your hand.
I wait for my master to nod.

lines.zh: 这个东西我能整个裹住
lines.en: I could wrap all of it up.
My body is already wet.
I bounce off your leg.
I flatten against your shoe.
You move and I am flung off.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你身上留下一片湿
lines.en: I leave a wet patch on you.

lines.zh: 我被撞散了一点，又合起来
lines.en: I am splashed apart and pull back together.
You knock me into two blobs.
We meet, and your shoe is wet.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的膝盖上滑下去
lines.en: I stick to your knee and slide off.
I bounce back and hit again.

lines.zh: 我的边在地上拖出一道水痕
lines.en: My edge leaves a wet streak.
Another small ball hops over.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，合成一团
lines.en: We meet and merge into one mass.

lines.zh: 她又分开了，黏在我边上
lines.en: She splits off and sticks to my side.
We hop in the same rhythm.
The two of us follow our master.
Her core is smaller than mine.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，边黏着边
lines.en: We lean together, edges stuck.

lines.zh: 我们一起弹到同一个台阶上
lines.en: We hop onto the same step.

lines.zh: 她替我收起漏出去的一点
lines.en: She gathers a bit that leaked out of me.
Our rhythm grows more alike.

lines.zh: 我把身体压下去，包住它
lines.en: I press my body down and wrap it.
It sinks slowly inside me.
I push it to my master's feet.
I swallow it and spit it out.
I take it, stuck to my surface.
I spread my body over it.
It sinks halfway into me.
I carry it under my body.
I spit it out, still dry.

lines.zh: 我抬起一半身体，露出来
lines.en: I lift half my body to show it.
I stop, my body drawn tight.
The way my master points is you.

lines.zh: 我开始一下一下地弹近
lines.en: I begin hopping closer, beat by beat.

lines.zh: 主人指的地方就是这里
lines.en: This is the place my master pointed to.
I stop and my body tightens.

lines.zh: 我朝主人的方向看了一眼
lines.en: I glance toward my master.
My edge begins to push forward.

lines.zh: 你站着的地方，我够得到
lines.en: Where you stand is within my reach.
One hop and I am at your feet.
I have no teeth, but I can press.
My master has not told me to stop.
I bring my core to my center.
You retreat, and I hop after.
Ripples cross my surface.
I follow you hop by hop.
Wherever you run, I hop there.
My hops come faster and faster.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的边，滑了一下
lines.en: You step on my edge and slip.
I follow hop by hop, steady.
You go round a post; I hop past.

lines.zh: 我的身体在地上粘住落叶
lines.en: My body sticks the fallen leaves.
You step on my trail and slip half a step.
I am not fast, but I do not tire.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，弹得更远
lines.en: I flatten and hop farther.
You back to the wall; it is dry there.
I pause, then hop again.

lines.zh: 我的影子是一小团，很圆
lines.en: My shadow is a small round blot.

lines.zh: 你在看我的时候，我在算距离
lines.en: While you watch, I measure the gap.

lines.zh: 我每一跳都比上一跳近
lines.en: Each hop brings me nearer.
I throw my whole body at you.
I press down on your foot, heavy.
My body smears over your hand.
I hit and stick, not letting go.
I leap bodily into you.
I press down on your toe.

lines.zh: 我的身体糊住你的手腕
lines.en: My body smears over your wrist.
I hit and stick fast.

lines.zh: 我从你的膝上滑到脚背
lines.en: I slide from your knee to your foot.

lines.zh: 你甩了一下，我才掉下去
lines.en: You shake me off at last.
My master summons me.

lines.zh: 我先是一小团，然后长大
lines.en: I start as a small blob and grow.
I land and bounce twice.
I look up at my master.
My body still carries a glow.
I begin as a drop of water.
I gather slowly into a blob.

lines.zh: 我在主人脚边弹了一下
lines.en: I bounce once at my master's feet.
My body is still trembling.
A small wet patch appears on the ground.
I look up to find my master.
I try a longer hop.
A light passes through me.
I roll half a turn before stopping.

lines.zh: 火烤得我冒气，我缩了一圈
lines.en: Fire makes me steam and I shrink a size.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，摊成一片
lines.en: I fall from height and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 我本来就湿，可这水里我散开了
lines.en: I am already wet, yet I spread apart in this water.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹散成一地水点
lines.en: The blast scatters me into droplets.

lines.zh: 这一箭穿过去，我漏了一点。
lines.en: The arrow went through and I leaked a little.
That force leaves me trembling.

lines.zh: 我越来越小，也越来越慢
lines.en: I grow smaller and slower.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我一瞬间硬了
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I go rigid for a moment.

lines.zh: 下面的地没了，我一路散开
lines.en: The ground is gone; I come apart as I fall.
